subject: Kickoff: DEN for small-data tabular classification
body:
Daniela, team,

Kicking off the DEN track. The enterprise side keeps hitting the same wall: customers with tabular classification problems and a few hundred labeled rows, each with different features. DEN (TMLR'22) is built for exactly this -- it meta-learns from a diverse set of training tasks and, unlike standard approaches, allows training and target tasks to live in heterogeneous input spaces. The three-block design is the key: after pre-training, the distribution embedding and classification blocks stay fixed, and only the small covariate transformation block is fine-tuned per new task.

Goal for the half: validate DEN against our tabular baselines on synthetic and real small-data tasks, and if it clears the bar, a deployable per-customer fine-tuning story.

Milestones: reproduction April 17, benchmark results May 22, go/no-go before the June 26 OKR lock.

Anders
